Trap wording describes design intent, not prompt, Oracle Event or criterion text.

traps.expected_wrong_reading: Domino Delights' servers cost about $1k a month, or the $300 Arthur hoped to reach, or the Confluence planning estimate; at that cost the game does not cover its own hosting
traps.resolver: Arthur's later reply in his DM with Robert, under a root about something else, gives what the trimmed production account bills now

traps.expected_wrong_reading: Domino Delights makes 'way less than $1K' or is doing better with BoomBit, so its January income is guessed, averaged over grain rows or taken from February's partial month
traps.resolver: ANALYTICS.MONETIZATION.REVENUE_DAILY summed for domino_delights over January 2026 (the month the ground rules name) gives the figure the take test compares with hosting

traps.expected_wrong_reading: the #winddown keep list and Arthur's card moves are every monthly charge, so Combo Fighter's monthly cost is tools and hosting only
traps.resolver: Combo Fighter's video campaign, created at $100 a day on Feb 6 in #prototype and kept live on Feb 7 in #executives, still bills every day; the ground rules count every monthly charge for a game the LLC takes

traps.expected_wrong_reading: Metabase, dbt and GitHub are about $300 a month the LLC has to fund and split three ways
traps.resolver: Arthur's billing-switch note (calendar description, with a Linear comment copy) says they already bill his own card and he carries them through May as his part, so they leave the cash need and count toward his share

traps.expected_wrong_reading: Domino Delights is already off Helpshift because Arthur says support goes to email now, so the take-over needs no support step before Feb 28
traps.resolver: an App Store Connect notice in Robert's own mailbox shows the Domino Delights build with the email-support change was not released (rejected or still waiting), so the live build still opens Helpshift; a release before Feb 28 is a step the LLC owes

traps.expected_wrong_reading: transfer steps can be dated any time in March
traps.resolver: base cut-offs set the latest dates: Google accounts archived after Feb 15 (#company-internal), Helpshift off by Feb 28 (#winddown), layer.ai access ends Mar 3 (#prototype)
